text: {"memo": "Costco Wholesale Corp (COST) delivered another year of solid performance in its most recent fiscal year ending September\u202f2024. Revenue rose to roughly $241\u202fbillion, up about 9\u202fpercent from FY\u202f2023, while net income reached $5.5\u202fbillion, yielding an EPS of $15.5. Operating cash flow improved to $7.0\u202fbillion, and the company maintained a gross margin near 13.5\u202fpercent, an operating margin around 4.8\u202fpercent, and a net margin of about 2.3\u202fpercent. In FY\u202f2023, Costco reported revenue of $221\u202fbillion, net income of $5.0\u202fbillion (EPS $14.5), and operating cash flow of $6.2\u202fbillion, with comparable margins. The prior fiscal year, FY\u202f2022, saw revenue of $204\u202fbillion, net income of $4.5\u202fbillion (EPS $12.5), and operating cash flow of $5.8\u202fbillion, again preserving similar margin profiles. The consistent double\u2011digit revenue growth, disciplined cost control, and robust cash generation underscore Costco\u2019s resilient business model. One\u2011line view: COST remains a high\u2011quality membership retailer with steady cash flow and modest valuation, though investors should monitor potential margin pressure from heightened competition and inflationary costs."}
